build_unity_xm_transformer_model: build a unity_xm_transformer model instance with encoder, decoder, and multitask decoders for speech to text
build_decoder_with_pretrained_weights: build a transformer decoder loaded from pretrained weights with optional layer discarding and finetuning
build_text_decoder_for_translation: build a text decoder for the first-pass translation module with configurable layers and dropout
forward_unity_xm_transformer: run the forward pass through MT decoder, T2U encoder, and T2U decoder for speech synthesis
configure_unity_architecture: configure the unity_xm_transformer architecture with default encoder, decoder, and adaptor arguments
